notes.title: How About Spikes [Version 1.1 - Speedrun Update]
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
long time no see!

Here is the patchlog for the new Speedrun Update.

Changes:
- Remade all menus (Fixed UI/HUD scaling on different resolutions)
- Added new Speedrun mode
- Online Speedrun leaderboard now available
- Added new animations
- Added new secrets to multiple levels
- Reduced overall enemy count in later areas
- Added more checkpoints in some areas
- Tweaked HUD
- Reduced health of final boss
- Changed appearance of lens flares and god rays

Bugfixes:
- Fixed a bug where the player could get stuck after entering a warpzone in demons keep
- Fixed a bug where the game would not properly scale, when changing between windowed and fullscreen mode
- Fixed hitboxes of skeleton enemies
- Fixed a bug where some achievements wouldn't be triggered
- Fixed a bug where picked ultra souls wouldn't be saved
- Fixed a bug  where a save file could get corrupted after an update

Thank you for playing How About Spikes!
If there are more things you want to see changed or you found new bugs, just let me know!

Have fun!

- SoulPixel

notes.title: How About Spikes [Patch 20]
notes.content:
So this is it.
The final patch before the release tomorow.
Please contact me, if you encounter any game breaking bugs!
I will support this game post launch with bugfixes and content updates.

Changes:

- Added new decoration to some levels
- Pausing the game in multiplayer will now spawn a pause icon above your head
- Orb holders now have a new sprite for being activated
- Glass blocks are now synchronised in multiplayer
- Added a refkection to the other player in multiplayer
- Changed the saving icon
- Added info text to the multiplayer screen

Bugfixes:

- Fixed a bug, where the other player could activate the vibration of the controller of the other player
- Fixed a bug, where lava and red spikes would kill both players in multiplayer
- Fixed an area in demons keep, where the player could see under the ground
- Fixed a bug, where the transition between 2 areas in overcast peak would not work
- Fixed a bug, where the player would sometimes only recieve 1 soul for collecting 2
- Fixed a bug, where the boss would get stuck underground, if the player died in the death animation of the boss

Thanks for your support and let's be hyped for tomorow!

- SoulPixel

notes.title: How About Spikes [Patch 18]
notes.content:
Bugfixes? Bugfixes!

Changes:

- Shortened the disconnect time, when not finding a host
- Changed soundtrack for Overcast Peak
- Bosses now have double the amount of health, when playing in multiplayer
- Levers now synchronise in multiplayer
- Souls now synchronise in multiplayer
- Players can now walk between rooms in multiplayer
- Improved hitbox and AI of the pirate enemy
- Changed parts of multiple levels


Bugfixes:

- Fixed a bug, where dying in multiplayer would result in the player spawning out of the map
- Fixed a bug, where the door at Skullcoin Bay would be already open

Multiplayer will probably get out of beta post launch. It's quite a huge task and I want to focus more on fixing game breaking bugs. Thank you for following the development of How About Spikes!

Have a nice day!

- SoulPixel

It's still in beta, a lot of features are missing and it is buggy as hell.
But you can already play the tutorial with someone else! yay

[b][/b]

[b][/b]
Multiple Savefiles will come soon!

Have a nice day!
